messages:
mira: weekend poll — who’s up for a quick thing this sat?
A) sunrise coffee + sourdough picnic :coffee:
B) 6-mile forest hike :hiking_boot:
C) 10k run (sam is already racing) :runner:
D) full sleep-in :zzz:
vote with emoji or reply!

anya: Ooh coffee picnic please. I can bring jam + a thermos. :raised_hands:

sam: Running the 10k so i’m out for hike/picnic morning, but cheer from afar :sweat_smile: Good luck!

chris: Hike sounds awesome. 8:30 start OK? Which trail — Redwood Ridge or Lakeside Loop?

mira: Redwood Ridge preferred. Meet 08:20 at North Lot? Or we can meet 08:00 by 3rd & Pine BART for carpool. Thoughts?

devon: I’ll be in SF but can join for coffee picnic after — big sleep-in energy here. If picnic, I’ll bring sourdough.

anya: Jam and marmalade contest confirmed. I’ll also bring a tiny speaker :musical_note: please no full-on EDM pls :grimacing:

reminder-bot: @channel Free coffee in kitchen on Friday 10:00-11:00 — don't miss it! :coffee:

chris: FYI small chance of drizzle (10%) Sat morning per weather app. Bring layers and a light rain jacket just in case.

mira: quick tally from replies: coffee picnic :coffee: x3 (mira, anya, devon), hike :hiking_boot: x1 (chris), run :runner: x1 (sam), sleep :zzz: x1 (liza)

liza: Sleep-in champion here. Someone take my share of sourdough pls. :wave: I may pop by for coffee later though.

mira: Plan: i’ll check weather at 07:00 Sat. If <40% chance of rain we do picnic (meet Pier 17 09:30). If rain >=40% we pivot to Redwood Ridge hike (meet North Lot 08:20). Will post final by 07:15.

anya: Perfect. If picnic, i’ll also bring greek yogurt + granola for communal bowl. :yum:

sam: Smash it, team. Post pics or it didn’t happen :camera_with_flash:

mira: ok locking this in — will update early Sat. Have a great rest of week! :sparkles:
